ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT Name,xtype FROM sysobjects WHERE Name='POS_TwrDoEksportu' AND xtype in (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF', N'FS', N'FT')) drop function CDN.POS_TwrDoEksportu;

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.POS_TwrDoEksportu (@PointOfSaleId int,@rowVersion int) RETURNS @twr TABLE ( TwrGidNumer int, TwrLp int, TwrStawkaPodSpr decimal(5,2), TwrLastMod int ) AS BEGIN insert into @twr select Twr_GIDNumer, row_number() over (order by Twr_GIDNumer) as row,Twr_StawkaPodSpr,Twr_LastModL from (select distinct Twr_GIDNumer,Twr_StawkaPodSpr,Twr_LastModL from cdn.PicoKonfig join cdn.PicoStanowiska on pck_picoid = psa_pckid outer apply cdn.PobierzDrzewoGrupTowarowych(PcK_TwGENumer,DEFAULT,DEFAULT,1,DEFAULT,DEFAULT) join cdn.TwrGrupy on TwG_GIDNumer = GidNumer AND TwG_GIDTyp = Gidtyp join cdn.twrlinki on TwL_GrOTyp = Gidtyp and Twl_GroNumer = GidNumer and TwL_Lisc = 1 join cdn.twrkarty on TwL_GIDNumer = Twr_GIDNumer and Twr_GIDTyp = Twl_Gidtyp where psa_id = @PointOfSaleId AND Twr_Typ in (1,2) AND Twr_Kaucja = 0 AND Twr_LastModL > @rowVersion) as y
RETURN END
GRANT SELECT ON CDN.POS_TwrDoEksportu TO CDNRaport
